newsitem.title: USA: Hollinger, Thomson, Cox swap paper ownership.
newsitem.headline: Hollinger, Thomson, Cox swap paper ownership.

text.p: Hollinger International Inc, Cox Newspapers and Thomson Newspapers said Friday that they have agreed in principle to exchange ownership in nine newspapers.
Thomson, a unit of Thomson Corp, will transfer to Hollinger three newspapers -- one each in Illinois, Oklahoma and Michigan -- with a combined circulation of about 67,000.
Hollinger will transfer to Thomson four newspapers in Indiana with a combined circulation of about 12,000, the companies said.

Cox Newspapers will gain a Texas newspaper and a North Carolina newspaper with a combined circulation of about 15,000 from Hollinger, they said. Cox Newspapers is a privately held subsidiary of Cox Enterprises Inc, which owns a controlling interest in Cox Communications Inc.
In August Cox and Thomson agreed in principle to swap ownership in eight newspapers.
The companies said they expect the latest transactions to be completed simultaneously with those of August.
